title: The Late Ledger
author: Mara Iversen
blurb: Lior Pemberton, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
